title: Cascadia Empowered
summary: Cascadia Empowered is an Arcane Enhancement for Secondary weapons that deals a flat amount of damage based on Status Effect, matching the status's damage type.
extract:
Cascadia Empowered is an Arcane Enhancement for Secondary weapons that deals a flat amount of damage based on Status Effect, matching the status's damage type.

Effect

Acquisition
Cascadia Empowered can be purchased from Cavalero for  7,500, requiring Rank 3 - Guardian with The Holdfasts. It can also be dropped by Thrax Centurion, Thrax Legatus, and Void Angels on the Zariman Ten Zero.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Farming Tips
Thrax enemies are abundant in Mobile Defense and Void Cascade missions.
The Zariman Arcane drop is considered as a mod drop, and is thus affected by The Steel Path and Mod Drop Chance Booster.

Notes
Creates an extra instance of damage when proccing a status effect.
More than 1 status proc on a single hit (>100% Status chance) will properly add extra damage, but will be displayed as a single damage number.
Not affected by damage, element, physical,  Galvanized Shot stacks,  Synth Charge, or critical mods and bonuses.
Affected by faction mods and bonuses once.
Not affected by  Eclipse or  Garuda's passive.
Triggers on  Toxin procs by  Toxic Lash.
Does not trigger on  Void procs by  Xata's Whisper, and  Cold spores of  Dual Coda Torxica.
Affected by Damage Vulnerability like  Caliban's  Sentient Wrath ,  Gara's  Mass Vitrify and  Splinter Storm.
Not affected by weakspots, but is affected by enemy damage reduction. For example, striking a Nox in the face will still have Cascadia Empowered's damage reduced by its body's damage reduction.
Not affected by weapon falloff such as on shotguns and explosions.
Can proc off of  Zenurik's  Temporal Shot bonus when used with  Seeking Talons.

Tips
Indirectly affected by Fire Rate and Multishot mods.
Unlike other secondary arcanes, Cascadia Empowered has no activation conditions, giving weapons more up-front damage to activate other conditional effects such as  Galvanized Diffusion.
Most effective on weapons with high status proc rates (Status Chance per Pellet × Fire Rate × Innate Multishot × Explosions). In order of highest base burst proc rate, these include:
 Kompressa Prime (9.6 on direct hits),  Twin Grakatas (6.6),  Kuva Brakk (6.5),  Catabolyst (5.2),  Kuva Nukor (5),  Tenet Cycron (4.8),  Gaze (Secondary) (4.7 with Flutterfire or Ramflare),  Twin Kohmak (4.6 at full spool),  Zakti Prime (4.2 on direct hits),  Quatz (4.1 on auto).
 Seeking Talons causes all hits to proc  Slash, adding an extra instance of Cascadia Empowered to every hit from the secondary weapon, except for status ticks.
